tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products from independent Shopify merchants. Returns products with a display price, store count, a Dercora product page `url`, and the merchant `buyUrl`. Pass `ships_to` (ISO country) so prices and availability match the buyer. Use `nextCursor` for more results.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one product's description, highlights, specs and every merchant offer (seller, price, availability, buy link). `id` comes from search_products.
